what: Hovering a cell in the 3-column grid on the dark ink panel turns on a rounded paper card (6px corners) inside the cell in .3s, the photo inside scales up 1.08x, and the hidden price line appears with it — name text that was invisible because it matched the panel’s ink color shows up on the card. Releasing hover turns it off over the same length. On devices without hover, the price line is always visible with no card

options.--fx-dur: On and off duration (via style), default .3s
options.[data-fx-part=sheet]: Card that lights up (empty span, direct child of the element) — the user paints a paper-texture-like background here
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Growing photo (optional) — overflow: hidden on the wrapping cell
options.[data-fx-part=reveal]: Line shown only when the card is active (optional) — price · See more
